sourceNotes: This pass started from https://www.wyoleg.gov on 2026-09-08 and stayed on wyoleg.gov. The prior primaryGovUrl was health.wyo.gov. The stored recreational citation was 2025 HB0191, which the House did not consider for introduction on 2025-02-03. That bill would have replaced criminal possession of small amounts with a civil fine; it is not law. Current W.S. 35-7-1031(c) appears in 2025 SF0074, enrolled as Chapter 123, signed on 2025-03-06, and effective 2025-07-01: possession of a controlled substance remains unlawful, and no practitioner may prescribe marijuana except an FDA-approved drug such as dronabinol. The 2026 HB0166 proposal to reschedule marijuana also was not introduced. Statute PDFs under /statutes/compress/ were not cited. The legislation pages are an Angular app; fetch returns a shell, so these rows require a browser.
